text: You, based on your past reviews, tend to like recipes featuring fresh ginger, spaghetti, Chinese cuisine, sesame oil, and cream of chicken soup. However, the recommended recipe, "Tequila Lime Chicken from Applebee's", does not feature any of these ingredients, which is a trade-off [F13]. On the other hand, this recipe is in line with your usual pattern of having higher protein content [F5]. It also takes about 50 minutes to prepare, which is slightly longer than your typical recipe time of about 40 minutes [F3, F9].
